learning.title: English learning
learning.missing: Learn is missing from this toolbar. If it already contains 24 actions, remove one action first.
learning.humanVoice: Prefer Youdao recorded pronunciation, with Microsoft speech fallback
learning.online: Add online English definitions and examples
learning.privacy: Local lookup stays offline. Choosing Learn sends content to your selected AI service. Optional English definitions use Free Dictionary API. Pronunciation sends the entry to Youdao or Microsoft.
learning.deck: Target deck (or enter a new name)
learning.recall: Recall · Read the word, recall its meaning
learning.typing: Typing · Read the meaning, type the word
learning.install: Install and open Anki. In Tools → Add-ons → Get Add-ons, enter 2055492159. Restart Anki, then check the connection.
learning.fsrsHint: Anki schedules reviews. To use FSRS, enable it in Anki's deck options; it applies to all decks. WinOne does not change existing review schedules.
learning.templatesHint: Choose the provider, model and extra instructions in the toolbar's Learn action. Templates below are selected by input type.
